modules.name: Qorvo DWM3001C UWB module
modules.summary: Fully integrated ultra-wideband (UWB) transceiver module for precise two-way ranging and RTLS positioning — the Qorvo DW3110 UWB IC + a Nordic nRF52833 BLE MCU + PCB antenna in one module.
notes: UWB ranging accuracy depends on ANTENNA POLARIZATION. The DWM3001C antenna is vertically polarized, so mount every module UPRIGHT and keep all anchors AND tags co-polarized (all vertical). If two antennas are perpendicular to each other the link uses the horizontally-polarized pattern, which has NULLS at some angles that cut range and add location error. This applies to essentially every UWB ranging device (anchor + tag), not just the DWM3001C. [Qorvo DWM3001C datasheet Rev F, Oct 2025, §6 Antenna Performance, Table 11]
AES key is stored in OTP (0x078-0x07F, big-endian) for secure ranging. [DWM3001C datasheet, memory map]

spec.source: Qorvo DWM3001C datasheet Rev F, Oct 2025

modules.name: NUCLEO-L452RE (STM32 Nucleo, STM32L452RE)

modules.name: NUCLEO-L476RG (STM32 Nucleo, STM32L476RG)

modules.name: NUCLEO-U575ZI-Q (STM32 Nucleo, STM32U575ZI)

not_for: production hardware (it is an eval board, not a module)

modules.name: NUCLEO-WL55JC (STM32 Nucleo, STM32WL55JC)
modules.summary: STM32 Nucleo-64 development board built around the STM32WL55JC (Cortex-M4 + M0+ at 48 MHz, 256 KB flash / 64 KB RAM) with integrated sub-GHz LoRa / (G)FSK radio. Carries an on-board ST-LINK debugger/programmer, USB, and Arduino + ST morpho headers.
not_for: production hardware (it is an eval board, not a module)

modules.name: STM32F4DISCOVERY (STM32 Discovery, STM32F407VG)
modules.summary: The classic STM32F4 Discovery kit with on-board MEMS accel, MEMS mic and audio DAC. Core: STM32F407VG (Cortex-M4F at 168 MHz, 1 MB flash / 192 KB RAM).

modules.name: STM32F429I-DISC1 (STM32 Discovery, STM32F429ZI)
modules.summary: STM32F429 Discovery kit with a 2.4-inch QVGA TFT LCD, SDRAM and gyroscope. Core: STM32F429ZI (Cortex-M4F at 180 MHz, 2 MB flash / 256 KB RAM).

modules.name: STM32H747I-DISCO (STM32 Discovery, STM32H747XI)
modules.summary: Dual-core STM32H7 Discovery kit with 4-inch capacitive touch LCD, Wi-Fi, audio and camera connector. Core: STM32H747XI (dual Cortex-M7 + Cortex-M4 at 480 MHz, 2 MB flash / 1 MB RAM).

modules.name: STM32H7B3I-DK (STM32 Discovery, STM32H7B3LI)
modules.summary: STM32H7B3 Discovery kit with a 4.3-inch TFT-LCD, octo-SPI flash and TouchGFX-ready graphics stack. Core: STM32H7B3LI (Cortex-M7 at 280 MHz, 2 MB flash / 1.4 MB RAM).

modules.name: STM32L4R9I-DISCO (STM32 Discovery, STM32L4R9AI)
modules.summary: Ultra-low-power STM32L4+ Discovery kit with a 1.2-inch round AMOLED MIPI-DSI display. Core: STM32L4R9AI (Cortex-M4F at 120 MHz, 2 MB flash / 640 KB RAM).

modules.name: B-L475E-IOT01A (STM32 Discovery, STM32L475VG)
modules.summary: STM32L4 IoT Discovery node: Wi-Fi, BLE, sub-GHz, NFC, plus a full MEMS sensor suite (accel, gyro, mag, pressure, humidity, mic, ToF). Core: STM32L475VG (Cortex-M4F at 80 MHz, 1 MB flash / 128 KB RAM).

modules.name: B-U585I-IOT02A (STM32 Discovery, STM32U585AI)
modules.summary: STM32U5 IoT Discovery node with Arm TrustZone, Wi-Fi, BLE, and an on-board MEMS sensor suite for secure IoT. Core: STM32U585AI (Cortex-M33 at 160 MHz, 2 MB flash / 786 KB RAM).

modules.name: STM32U5A9J-DK (STM32 Discovery, STM32U5A9NJ)
modules.summary: High-end STM32U5 Discovery kit with a 2.47-inch round MIPI-DSI AMOLED touch display and rich multimedia I/O. Core: STM32U5A9NJ (Cortex-M33 at 160 MHz, 4 MB flash / 2.5 MB RAM).

modules.name: STM32MP157F-DK2 (STM32 Discovery, STM32MP157F)
modules.summary: STM32MP1 microprocessor Discovery kit running Linux on dual Cortex-A7 with a Cortex-M4 coprocessor, 4-inch touch LCD, Wi-Fi/BT and camera connector. Core: STM32MP157F (dual Cortex-A7 + Cortex-M4 at 800 MHz A7 / 209 MHz M4, external DDR (no internal flash)).

modules.name: STM32N6570-DK (STM32 Discovery, STM32N657X0)
modules.summary: STM32N6 Discovery kit pairing a Cortex-M55 with the Neural-ART NPU (~600 GOPS) for on-device vision/edge-AI, with camera and LCD. Core: STM32N657X0 (Cortex-M55 + Neural-ART NPU at 800 MHz, external (no internal flash)).

modules.name: STM32H743I-EVAL (STM32 full evaluation board, STM32H743XI)
modules.summary: Full evaluation board for the STM32H743 line with TFT-LCD, Ethernet, USB OTG, audio and extensive expansion. Core: STM32H743XI (Cortex-M7 at 480 MHz, 2 MB flash / 1 MB RAM).
good_for: bring-up of the full peripheral set

modules.name: STM32F429I-EVAL (STM32 full evaluation board, STM32F429NI)
modules.summary: Full evaluation board for high-density STM32F4 parts with TFT-LCD, SDRAM, Ethernet and camera interface. Core: STM32F429NI (Cortex-M4F at 180 MHz, 2 MB flash / 256 KB RAM).
good_for: bring-up of the full peripheral set

modules.name: STM32U575I-EV (STM32 full evaluation board, STM32U575AI)
modules.summary: Full evaluation board for the ultra-low-power STM32U5 line with TFT-LCD, audio, and rich peripheral breakout. Core: STM32U575AI (Cortex-M33 at 160 MHz, 2 MB flash / 786 KB RAM).
good_for: bring-up of the full peripheral set

modules.name: STLINK-V3SET (ST debug probe)
modules.summary: Modular in-circuit debugger and programmer for STM32/STM8 with SWD/JTAG, virtual COM port, SWIM and bridge (SPI/I2C/CAN/GPIO) interfaces.
good_for: debugging / flashing any STM32 or STM8 target
not_for: running application code (it is a debug probe, not a target)

modules.name: STLINK-V3MINIE (ST debug probe)
modules.summary: Compact standalone STM32/STM8 debug probe (SWD + virtual COM port) in a low-cost minimal form factor.
good_for: embedding a probe into a custom fixture
not_for: running application code (it is a debug probe, not a target)

modules.name: ST-LINK/V2 (ST debug probe)
modules.summary: Classic in-circuit debugger and programmer for STM32 and STM8 over SWD/JTAG/SWIM.
not_for: running application code (it is a debug probe, not a target)

modules.name: X-NUCLEO-IKS01A3 (X-NUCLEO expansion shield)
modules.summary: MEMS motion + environmental sensor expansion board (LSM6DSO 6-axis IMU, LIS2MDL mag, LIS2DW12 accel, LPS22HH pressure, HTS221 humidity, STTS751 temp) on Arduino-compatible headers.
good_for: adding a full MEMS sensor suite to any Nucleo
not_for: standalone use (it is a shield, needs a Nucleo host)

modules.name: X-NUCLEO-IKS4A1 (X-NUCLEO expansion shield)
modules.summary: MEMS sensor-hub expansion board (LSM6DSV16X IMU with embedded sensor hub + Qvar, LIS2MDL, LIS2DUXS12, LPS22DF, SHT40AD) for Nucleo.
not_for: standalone use (it is a shield, needs a Nucleo host)

modules.name: X-NUCLEO-53L5A1 (X-NUCLEO expansion shield)
modules.summary: Time-of-Flight ranging expansion board carrying a VL53L5CX 8x8 multizone ToF sensor (plus spare breakout) for Nucleo.
not_for: standalone use (it is a shield, needs a Nucleo host)

modules.name: X-NUCLEO-BNRG2A1 (X-NUCLEO expansion shield)
modules.summary: Bluetooth Low Energy expansion board based on the BlueNRG-2 network processor, adding BLE 5.0 connectivity to any Nucleo.
good_for: adding BLE to a wired STM32 Nucleo
not_for: standalone use (it is a shield, needs a Nucleo host)

modules.name: X-NUCLEO-NFC08A1 (X-NUCLEO expansion shield)
modules.summary: Dynamic NFC/RFID tag expansion board based on the ST25DV64K, giving a Nucleo an energy-harvesting NFC Type-5 tag with I2C access.
not_for: standalone use (it is a shield, needs a Nucleo host)

modules.name: X-NUCLEO-IHM07M1 (X-NUCLEO expansion shield)
modules.summary: Three-phase brushless (BLDC/PMSM) motor driver expansion board based on the L6230 DMOS driver, for FOC/six-step motor control from a Nucleo.
not_for: standalone use (it is a shield, needs a Nucleo host)

modules.name: Hakko FX-888D soldering station
modules.summary: Digital 70 W temperature-controlled soldering station; the shop-standard workhorse for through-hole and most SMD hand work.
notes: Buy genuine Hakko T18 tips; clones run cold and oxidize fast.
The newer FX-888DX adds a cleaner UI but the FX-888D is the value pick.

modules.name: Pinecil V2 portable soldering iron
modules.summary: USB-C / DC pocket soldering iron (open IronOS firmware) that heats in seconds; the best cheap iron and a great travel/field tool.
good_for: powering from a USB-C PD pack or laptop charger
not_for: high-thermal-mass joints without a 60 W+ PD supply
a bench station replacement for all-day production
notes: Needs a 65 W USB-C PD or 12-20 V DC source to hit full power; a weak charger throttles it.

modules.name: Weller WE1010 soldering station
modules.summary: 70 W digital station; the common Hakko FX-888D alternative with the classic Weller tip ecosystem.
good_for: general through-hole and SMD hand soldering
shops already standardized on Weller ET tips
notes: Uses Weller ET-series tips; plentiful but pricier than Hakko T18.

modules.name: JBC CD-2BE soldering station
modules.summary: Pro-grade station whose cartridge tips recover temperature almost instantly; the gold standard for production and rework benches.
good_for: lead-free work on heavy ground planes
not_for: hobby budgets (several times the price of an FX-888D)
notes: C210/C245 cartridge tips integrate the heater + sensor in the tip, which is why recovery is so fast.
Overkill for occasional hobby use; buy it when soldering is your job.

modules.name: Quick 861DW hot-air rework station
modules.summary: 1000 W brushless-fan hot-air station; the hobbyist favorite for SMD rework, chip removal, and reflowing fine-pitch parts.
good_for: removing/placing QFN, QFP, SOIC and small BGA
not_for: large BGA where a hotplate preheat is needed
notes: Preheat the board (hotplate/IR) before lifting large or ground-heavy parts to avoid cracking.
Brushless fan is quiet and long-lived vs cheaper diaphragm-pump guns.

modules.name: Hakko FR-301 desoldering gun
modules.summary: Self-contained vacuum desoldering gun that clears through-hole joints in one pass; a huge time-saver over wick + pump.
notes: Clean the filter chamber and nozzle regularly or suction dies.
The built-in pump beats the classic bulb/spring 'solder sucker' for repeated work.

modules.name: Miniware MHP30 mini hotplate
modules.summary: Palm-sized 30x30 mm reflow hotplate for small PCBs; preheats boards and reflows tiny solder-paste assemblies without an oven.
good_for: reflowing small boards and modules with solder paste
not_for: boards larger than ~45 mm (edges run cold)
notes: For larger or more repeatable reflow, a toaster oven with a Controleo3 controller and a real profile is the classic DIY upgrade.
Needs a 65 W USB-C PD supply to reach lead-free paste temps.

modules.name: Fluke 87V industrial multimeter
modules.summary: True-RMS industrial handheld DMM; the reference-grade meter for accuracy, safety rating, and decades of reliability.
good_for: CAT III/IV mains and industrial work
not_for: bench logging/data capture (no PC link on base model)
notes: CAT III 1000 V / CAT IV 600 V safety rating matters when probing mains.
If you only do low-voltage electronics, the cheaper Fluke 117 or a Brymen covers it.

modules.name: Fluke 117 electrician's multimeter
modules.summary: True-RMS handheld DMM with non-contact voltage detect; Fluke reliability at a more accessible price than the 87V.

modules.name: Brymen BM235 multimeter
modules.summary: True-RMS handheld (the EEVblog-badged favorite) offering near-Fluke build and features for roughly half the price.
good_for: temperature, capacitance, duty cycle, low-Z mode
not_for: those who need the Fluke service/calibration ecosystem
notes: Sold in some regions as the EEVblog BM235; same meter.

modules.name: Aneng AN8008 pocket multimeter
modules.summary: Cheap true-RMS pocket DMM; a fine throw-in-the-bag second meter or a no-risk first meter for low-voltage electronics.
good_for: low-voltage bench electronics on a tight budget
not_for: mains or high-energy circuits (don't trust the CAT rating)
notes: Treat the safety rating as marketing; keep it on low-voltage DC/logic work, not mains.

modules.name: Rigol DM3058E bench multimeter
modules.summary: 5.5-digit bench DMM with USB/LAN; adds resolution, stability, and PC logging a handheld can't match.
not_for: fast transient capture (that's a scope's job)

modules.name: Rigol DHO804 oscilloscope
modules.summary: 12-bit 70 MHz 4-channel desktop scope; a compact, high-resolution entry scope that punches far above its price.
good_for: embedded / power / analog debug up to ~70 MHz
not_for: high-bandwidth RF or fast digital edges (>70 MHz)
notes: The 4-channel model is worth it if you ever debug SPI + I2C (or clock + data + CS) together.
Bandwidth can often be upgraded by license; buy the bandwidth you need now.

modules.name: Rigol DHO914S oscilloscope
modules.summary: 12-bit 125 MHz 4-channel scope with a built-in 25 MHz function generator and logic-analyzer option; a near-complete bench in one box.
good_for: mixed-signal debug with the built-in AWG and optional logic pod
12-bit resolution at higher bandwidth than the DHO804
not_for: deep protocol work needing many logic channels

modules.name: Siglent SDS1104X-E oscilloscope
modules.summary: Classic 100 MHz 4-channel 8-bit scope with deep protocol decode and fast waveform update; the long-standing value benchmark.
not_for: low-level signals where 12-bit scopes (DHO series) resolve more
notes: Great used/new value; the newer 12-bit Rigol DHO series is the main alternative to weigh.

modules.name: Rigol DS1054Z oscilloscope
modules.summary: The classic budget 50 MHz 4-channel scope that launched a generation of hobby benches; still a solid cheap first scope.
notes: Largely superseded by the 12-bit DHO800/900 at similar money; buy used or if you want the proven classic.

modules.name: Keysight DSOX1204G oscilloscope
modules.summary: Pro-tier 70-200 MHz 4-channel scope with a built-in WaveGen AWG; Keysight's low-noise front end and software in an entry chassis.
good_for: professional labs wanting Keysight quality on a budget chassis
not_for: hobby budgets (costs well above the Rigol/Siglent class)

modules.name: Saleae Logic 8 logic analyzer
modules.summary: 8-channel USB logic + analog analyzer with best-in-class software; the pro standard for protocol capture and decode.
good_for: mixed digital+analog capture on one tool
not_for: tight budgets (the software, not hardware, is what you pay for)
notes: The Saleae software works with cheaper hardware for casual use; you pay Saleae for the polish and support.

modules.name: DSLogic Plus logic analyzer
modules.summary: 16-channel USB analyzer with deep sample buffer and the open DSView software; a strong mid-tier alternative to Saleae.
good_for: longer/faster captures than cheap FX2 clones
not_for: those who specifically need Saleae's decoder library

modules.name: Generic FX2 8-channel logic analyzer
modules.summary: The ubiquitous ~$10 USB logic analyzer based on the Cypress FX2LP; works great with free sigrok/PulseView for slow buses.
good_for: cheap first logic analyzer for I2C/UART/slow SPI
a throwaway tool you won't cry over
not_for: fast buses (reliable only to a few MHz over USB)
notes: Flash it / use it with sigrok; the bundled vendor software is poor.
Sampling above ~8-24 MHz drops samples on USB 2.0; keep it to slow signals.

modules.name: Korad KA3005P bench power supply
modules.summary: Single-channel 30 V / 5 A linear programmable PSU with USB control; the standard affordable first bench supply.
good_for: clean low-noise power for analog/RF prototyping
current-limit (CC) protection while bringing up new boards
notes: Set the current limit before powering a new board; CC mode saves smoke on shorts.
Linear regulation = low noise, but it runs warm and heavy vs switching supplies.

modules.name: Rigol DP832 triple-output power supply
modules.summary: 3-channel programmable PSU (30 V/3 A, 30 V/3 A, 5 V/3 A) with readback and logging; the go-to multi-rail bench supply.
good_for: powering boards that need +rail, -rail, and logic together
not_for: tight budgets (step up from a single Korad)
notes: The low (5 V/3 A) channel is perfect for logic while the two 30 V rails feed op-amps/analog.

modules.name: Siglent SPD3303X power supply
modules.summary: Triple-output programmable PSU (2x 32 V/3.2 A + fixed rail) with a bright display and series/parallel modes; a strong DP832 rival.
good_for: dual-tracking rails for op-amp / analog bring-up
series/parallel for higher V or A

modules.name: Siglent SDG1032X function/arbitrary generator
modules.summary: 2-channel 30 MHz arbitrary waveform generator; injects clean test signals, sweeps, and arbitrary waveforms for analog/filter/sensor work.
good_for: stimulating filters, amplifiers, and sensor front ends
two independent channels for differential or clock+data
not_for: simple cases already covered by a scope's built-in AWG
notes: If your scope already has a built-in generator (e.g. DHO914S), you may not need a standalone AWG yet.

modules.name: SEGGER J-Link BASE / EDU debug probe
modules.summary: The industry-standard JTAG/SWD debug probe with fast flash download and broad toolchain support; EDU variant is a cheap non-commercial option.
good_for: fast, reliable flashing in CI and at the bench
not_for: commercial use on the low-cost EDU licence (licensing restriction)
non-ARM targets outside its supported list
notes: J-Link EDU / EDU Mini are for students and hobbyists only; buy BASE/PLUS for commercial work.
RTT gives you printf-style logging over SWD with no extra UART.

modules.name: ST-LINK/V3 debug probe (STLINK-V3SET)
modules.summary: ST's JTAG/SWD programmer-debugger for STM32/STM8 with a virtual COM port and bridge functions; cheap and essential for ST work.
not_for: features of a full J-Link on exotic cores
notes: The ST-LINK on a Nucleo/Discovery board can be used standalone; ST-LINK also appears as a dev board in the ST set.
STLINK-V3MINIE is a tiny low-cost variant for embedding in a jig.

modules.name: Black Magic Probe
modules.summary: Open-source SWD/JTAG probe with an on-board GDB server - no OpenOCD needed; just connect GDB straight to the probe.
good_for: GDB-native ARM Cortex-M debugging with zero middleware
a built-in USB UART alongside debug
not_for: targets outside its supported ARM set
notes: Presents two USB serial ports: one is the GDB server, one is a passthrough UART.

modules.name: DAPLink / CMSIS-DAP probe
modules.summary: Open CMSIS-DAP debug probe standard found on many dev boards and cheap standalone adapters; drag-and-drop flashing plus SWD debug.
good_for: cheap, open, cross-vendor ARM SWD debugging
works with pyOCD / OpenOCD out of the box
notes: CMSIS-DAP is the protocol; DAPLink is Arm's reference firmware - many boards expose it already.

modules.name: Nordic Power Profiler Kit II (PPK2)
modules.summary: Source-meter + ampere-meter that measures nA-to-amp current draw over time; the essential tool for optimizing battery-powered firmware.
good_for: profiling sleep/active current of low-power MCUs and sensors
finding the firmware event that spikes consumption
not_for: lab-grade DC analysis (Otii is more capable)
notes: Can both power the DUT (source mode) and measure an externally powered one (ampere mode).
Dynamic range covers ~200 nA to 1 A - ideal for coin-cell / energy-harvesting work.

modules.name: Qoitech Otii Arc Pro power analyzer
modules.summary: Pro power source/analyzer combining a precise programmable supply, high-res current logging, and UART capture in one tool.
good_for: correlating current with device UART logs on one timeline
repeatable supply + measurement for test benches

modules.name: AmScope SE400-Z stereo microscope
modules.summary: Binocular stereo zoom microscope with long working distance; the real tool for SMD inspection, fine soldering, and rework under magnification.
good_for: inspecting joints and PCB damage in true stereo/3D
long working distance to fit an iron underneath
not_for: screen-sharing / recording (no camera; add a trinocular model for that)
notes: Stereo (two eyepieces) gives the depth perception a flat USB scope can't; worth it for rework.
A boom/articulating stand beats a pillar stand for working over a board.

modules.name: Generic USB / HDMI digital microscope
modules.summary: Cheap digital microscope on a stand that shows a magnified PCB on a screen; fine for inspection and light SMD work on a budget.
good_for: budget SMD inspection and basic rework
showing/recording a board on a monitor
not_for: true stereo depth (it's a flat 2D image)
notes: Prefer an HDMI model with its own screen over a USB-to-PC one for less latency while soldering.
Short working distance on many units leaves no room for an iron; check before buying.

modules.name: RTL-SDR Blog V4 dongle
modules.summary: The best-regarded RTL2832U receive-only SDR dongle (~500 kHz-1.75 GHz) with a TCXO, bias-tee, and improved front end; the standard cheap SDR.
good_for: learning SDR, ADS-B, AIS, pagers, weather-sat, general RX
stable tuning (1 PPM TCXO) vs generic dongles
HF reception via its built-in direct-sampling
notes: A distinct, higher-quality product than the generic RTL2832U dongle already in the catalog; insist on the genuine 'RTL-SDR Blog V4' to get the TCXO and filtering.
Needs the RTL-SDR Blog driver branch for the V4's R828D front end.

modules.name: Airspy Mini SDR
modules.summary: Receive-only SDR with a 12-bit ADC and up to 6 MSPS; a big step up in dynamic range and bandwidth from an RTL-SDR dongle.
good_for: cleaner RX with 12-bit dynamic range (24-1800 MHz)
serious VHF/UHF monitoring and spectrum work
not_for: the lowest budgets (costs more than an RTL dongle)

modules.name: Hakko CHP-170 flush cutters
modules.summary: Precise micro flush cutters for trimming component leads clean to the board; a cheap tool you'll reach for constantly.
good_for: flush-trimming through-hole leads and zip ties
not_for: hardened steel wire or music wire (will nick the jaws)
notes: Keep a dedicated pair for soft metals only; cutting steel ruins the flush edge.

modules.name: Engineer PA-09 crimping pliers
modules.summary: Japanese universal crimper that does open-barrel contacts (Dupont, JST, Molex, JAM) extremely well; the hobbyist's connector-crimping answer.
good_for: one tool across many connector families
neat, reliable crimps without a per-series die set
notes: The PA-09 handles the common 2.0/2.54 mm hobby connectors; PA-21 covers larger barrels.

modules.name: Anti-static precision tweezers set
modules.summary: A set of fine ESD-safe tweezers (straight, curved, fine-point) for placing SMD parts and handling small components.
good_for: handling leads and wires under a microscope
not_for: prying or heavy mechanical work (fine tips bend)
notes: Get at least one straight and one curved (bent-tip) pair; the curved pair is what you'll use most for SMD.

modules.name: Stickvise PCB vise
modules.summary: Low-profile spring-loaded PCB vise that holds a board flat at bench level; ideal for soldering, probing, and inspection.
good_for: holding a bare PCB steady while soldering or probing
low, stable profile that fits under a microscope
not_for: holding odd-shaped or very large assemblies
work needing many articulated arms (use a third-hand)

modules.name: PanaVise 201 Junior PCB holder
modules.summary: Articulating multi-position vise head that tilts and rotates to any angle; the classic 'position the board where you want it' holder.
good_for: tilting/rotating a board to any working angle
holding assemblies, not just bare PCBs
pairing with the PanaVise base + accessories system
not_for: very low-profile microscope work (Stickvise sits flatter)

modules.name: Third-hand / helping-hands tool
modules.summary: Flexible gooseneck or alligator-clip arms that hold wires and boards together for soldering; the cheapest way to get extra hands.
good_for: holding two wires together to tin/solder
models with magnifier and base clips
not_for: rigid, precise PCB holding (use a Stickvise/PanaVise)
notes: Gooseneck/magnetic-base versions hold position far better than the classic two-alligator-clip cast base.

modules.name: Kester 63/37 leaded solder (0.031 in)
modules.summary: Eutectic 63/37 tin-lead rosin-core solder - the easiest-flowing, most forgiving solder for hand work and the default for learning.
good_for: beginner-friendly hand soldering (sharp eutectic melt point)
not_for: food/consumer contact or where lead is prohibited
notes: Lead is toxic: wash hands, don't eat at the bench, and use fume extraction.
0.031 in (0.8 mm) is the versatile default gauge; go thinner (0.02 in) for fine SMD.

modules.name: SAC305 lead-free solder wire
modules.summary: Rosin-core SAC305 (Sn96.5/Ag3/Cu0.5) lead-free solder for RoHS-compliant work; needs more heat and good flux to wet well.
not_for: beginners learning to solder (less forgiving than 63/37)
notes: Run ~20-30 C hotter than leaded and keep extra flux handy; joints look duller than leaded - that's normal.

modules.name: Soldering flux (no-clean paste / pen)
modules.summary: Extra flux (gel in a syringe or a flux pen) that makes solder wet and flow; essential for SMD, rework, and drag-soldering.
not_for: leaving on uncleaned for high-impedance analog (clean residues there)
replacing cored-solder flux for simple through-hole
notes: No-clean residue is usually fine to leave, but clean it off high-impedance / RF nodes with IPA.
Amtech-style tacky gel flux in a syringe is the hobby favorite for QFN/BGA work.

modules.name: Solder wick / desoldering braid
modules.summary: Flux-impregnated copper braid that wicks molten solder off pads and joints; the simplest desoldering and cleanup consumable.
good_for: cleaning excess solder off pads and bridges
not_for: clearing deep plated-through holes in bulk (a desolder gun is faster)
heat-sensitive pads (braid pulls a lot of heat)
notes: Match braid width to the job; add a little flux and let the braid - not the pad - take the heat.
No.2 / ~2 mm width is the handy all-rounder.

modules.name: Kapton (polyimide) tape
modules.summary: High-temperature polyimide tape that masks areas during hot-air rework and reflow; also handy for temporary insulation.
good_for: masking adjacent parts during hot-air rework

modules.name: Isopropyl alcohol >=99% (flux cleaner)
modules.summary: High-purity (>=99%) isopropyl alcohol for removing flux residue and cleaning boards; the standard bench solvent.
good_for: cleaning flux residue off finished boards
not_for: use near open flame / hot iron (flammable)
cleaning sensitive membrane switches or some plastics
notes: Use >=99% (anhydrous); drugstore 70% leaves water behind and dries slowly.
An acid brush or no-lint swab plus IPA lifts no-clean residue off RF/high-impedance nodes.

modules.name: ESD wrist strap + mat grounding kit
modules.summary: Grounded anti-static wrist strap and dissipative bench mat; cheap insurance against zapping MOSFETs, MCUs, and RF front ends.
good_for: handling static-sensitive ICs, MOSFETs, and RF parts
basic ESD discipline at any bench
not_for: live-mains work (never wear a hard-grounded strap near mains)
replacing proper ESD flooring/footwear in a controlled facility
notes: Clip the mat and strap to a common ground point (a known-good mains earth), not directly to a hot chassis.
A 1 Mohm resistor is built into the strap lead for safety - don't bypass it.

spec.contents: wrist strap + grounding cord + dissipative mat

chips.name: Acconeer A111 pulsed-coherent radar IC
chips.summary: Earlier Acconeer PCR IC used in a cited respiratory-rate study.

chips.name: Acconeer A121
chips.role: 60 GHz pulsed-coherent radar sensor (the sensing silicon inside XM125)
chips.summary: Pulsed coherent radar providing mm-level distance and sub-mm displacement via sparse IQ (5 kHz), with prebuilt distance/presence/breath services. 1 TX x 1 RX (no angle). Hosted by an STM32L431 on the XM125 module.

chips.name: AD8021 low-noise high-speed op-amp
chips.role: low-noise LNA / gain stages for sonar RX
chips.summary: Low-noise high-speed op-amp used for the two 20-40 dB gain stages of the imaging sonar buoy RX chain.

spec.role_here: RX LNA stage 1 (20 dB) + stage 2 (20-40 dB)

chips.name: AD8232 single-lead ECG analog front end
chips.role: biopotential analog front end (ECG instrumentation amp + filtering)
chips.summary: Integrated instrumentation amplifier + filtering AFE that recovers P-QRS-T morphology from a single ECG lead; the silicon on DFRobot SEN0213.

spec.extra: Lead-Off Detection (LO+/LO-) available but unexposed on SEN0213

chips.name: AD9361 2x2 RF agile transceiver
chips.summary: Wideband 2x2 RF transceiver (12-bit, 70 MHz-6 GHz class) that is the RF front end of the bladeRF 2.0 and USRP B210.

chips.name: AD9363 2x2 RF agile transceiver
chips.summary: Lower-tier sibling of the AD9361; the 'Pluto' transceiver that fronts PlutoSDR-class Zynq-7010 SDRs.

chips.name: ADG704 4-channel analog mux
chips.role: analog multiplexer (T/R switch, band / transducer select)
chips.summary: Low-on-resistance 4:1 analog mux used for T/R switching, transducer select and band-pass-filter select in the imaging sonar analog chain.

chips.name: ADI AD5940 bioimpedance / EIT AFE
chips.summary: High-precision bioimpedance analog front end used for contact electrical boundary / EIT measurements (EVAL-AD5940BIOZ, CN0565).

chips.name: ADI MAX86141 optical AFE
chips.role: Low-power optical PPG analog front end (multi-wavelength)
chips.summary: Optical (PPG) analog front end supporting multi-channel/multi-wavelength optical patches; MAX86170-class cited as sibling.

chips.name: ADS1115
chips.summary: Precision 16-bit delta-sigma ADC with 4 single-ended channels and a PGA. The brains of the ADS1115 breakout the analog cogs read through.

chips.name: TI ADS1299
chips.summary: Low-noise 8-channel, 24-bit simultaneous-sampling biopotential front-end (1-2 kHz). SPI. For clinical-grade muscle activation / fatigue sensing.

chips.name: ADS9224R 3 MSPS dual 16-bit SAR ADC
chips.summary: 3 MSPS dual 16-bit SAR ADC listed as the higher-rate alternative capture ADC for the imaging sonar buoy.

chips.name: Andar ADT6101P
chips.role: 60 GHz vitals radar SoC inside the HLK-LD6002B module
chips.summary: 60 GHz radar SoC underlying the HLK-LD6002B; runs Andar's vendor vitals algorithm to output HR / limited HRV / RR / micro-motion. Processed outputs only (no raw IF).

chips.name: AKM AK5816 60 GHz radar transceiver
chips.role: 60 GHz FMCW TDM-MIMO transceiver (in AK5816AIM AiM)
chips.summary: 60 GHz FMCW transceiver paired with a 4Tx4Rx antenna array in the AK5816AIM antenna-in-module; onboard radar processing.

chips.name: Allwinner A20
chips.summary: SoC: Cortex-A7 dual-core used in Pi4J-supported SBCs.

chips.name: Allwinner H3
chips.summary: SoC: Cortex-A7 quad-core used in Pi4J-supported SBCs.

chips.name: Amlogic S805
chips.summary: SoC: Cortex-A5 quad-core used in Pi4J-supported SBCs.

chips.name: AP2112 3.3 V LDO regulator
chips.summary: 3.3 V LDO powering the sonobuoy sensor-node logic rail downstream of the 18650 + TP4056.

chips.name: HLK-AS201 integrated IMU
chips.summary: The HLK-AS201's integrated attitude engine: 32-bit floating-point DSP (to 240 MHz) fusing 3-axis accel + 3-axis gyro + 3-axis mag + barometer, output over UART/BLE. Protocol confirmed by the Hi-Link datasheet V1.1.

chips.name: Avia HX711 24-bit load-cell ADC
chips.summary: 24-bit sigma-delta ADC with integrated low-noise amplifier for bridge/load-cell force sensing; 2-wire serial.

chips.name: TI AWR1843
chips.role: 77 GHz MIMO FMCW radar (2TX x 4RX) — GigaFlex muscle-sensing hardware
chips.summary: 77 GHz FMCW MIMO radar, 2 TX x 4 RX, raw IF via DCA1000. The exact chip CMU used in the GigaFlex radar-MMG paper; 77 GHz gives ~30% better displacement sensitivity than 60 GHz.

chips.name: BCM2710A1 (RP3A0)
chips.summary: The system-on-chip inside the Pi Zero 2 W Seed host: quad-core Cortex-A53.

chips.name: Broadcom BCM2835
chips.summary: SoC: ARM1176JZF-S single-core used in Pi4J-supported SBCs.

chips.name: Broadcom BCM2836
chips.summary: SoC: Cortex-A7 quad-core used in Pi4J-supported SBCs.

chips.name: Broadcom BCM2837
chips.summary: SoC: Cortex-A53 quad-core used in Pi4J-supported SBCs.

chips.name: Broadcom BCM2837B0
chips.summary: SoC: Cortex-A53 quad-core (1.4GHz) used in Pi4J-supported SBCs.

chips.name: BES2700 (Bluetooth / audio MCU)
chips.role: Bluetooth + audio co-processor on Mentra Live; handles BLE link to phone, I2S audio, RGB LED, buttons, on-chip VAD, battery voltage reporting
chips.summary: Dedicated BT/audio MCU on the Mentra Live glasses, linked to the MT6761 over UART /dev/ttyS1 @ 460800 (K900 JSON protocol). Forwards BLE data from the phone, manages the I2S speaker path (mh_starti2s), the frame RGB LED (cs_ledon/cs_ledoff), camera button events, voice-activity detection (sr_vad, <1mW), and reports battery voltage (hm_batv).

spec.functions: BLE bridge, I2S audio, RGB LED, buttons, VAD, battery

chips.name: Infineon BGT60TR13C
chips.role: 60 GHz FMCW radar (1TX x 3RX) — Google Project Soli gesture chip
chips.summary: 60 GHz FMCW radar, 1 TX x 3 RX, ~5 GHz BW, raw FIFO over SPI (ESP32-friendly). The Project Soli gesture-sensing chip.

chips.name: BME280 combined environmental sensor
chips.summary: Combined T/RH/P environmental sensor; the Seed agent ships a native driver. BMP280 is the pressure+temp-only sibling in the same package/address.

chips.name: Bosch BME680
chips.summary: BME280 T/RH/P die plus a MOx gas-resistance heater for VOC/IAQ. I2C @ 0x76/0x77. Full IAQ needs Bosch BSEC (licensing). Datasheet BST-BME680-DS001.

chips.name: BNO055 9-DOF absolute orientation IMU
chips.summary: 9-DOF IMU with a built-in fusion core outputting absolute orientation (quaternion/Euler) at 100 Hz.

chips.name: BNO085 9-DOF IMU with sensor-hub fusion
chips.summary: 9-DOF IMU with advanced SH-2 fusion firmware, referenced as the pose/attitude IMU option for the splat capture sensor head.

spec.role_here: attitude / pose sidecar for capture head

chips.name: Broadcom BCM43455 WiFi SoC (Nexmon CSI)
chips.role: WiFi radio used for Nexmon CSI capture (Pi 5/4/3B+)
chips.summary: Broadcom WiFi chip (BCM43455c0) on Raspberry Pi; patched with Nexmon to extract WiFi CSI for RF sensing.

chips.name: Silicon Labs CP2104 USB-UART bridge
chips.summary: USB-to-UART bridge providing the onboard serial path on the ANDAR LD6002 carrier (support IC, not a sensor).

chips.name: Decawave DW1000 UWB transceiver IC
chips.summary: First-gen UWB transceiver IC behind the DWM1001 module and MDEK1001 RTLS kit.

chips.name: DRV8837 H-bridge motor/transducer driver
chips.role: H-bridge driver for piezo TX drive
chips.summary: Low-voltage H-bridge driven antiphase from two GPIOs to produce ~6.6 Vpp piezo TX drive in the simple sonobuoy build.

chips.name: DS18B20 1-Wire digital thermometer
chips.summary: 1-Wire digital thermometer (-55..+125 C) used as the sonobuoy water-temperature element.

chips.name: Qorvo DW3110
chips.summary: UWB transceiver (channels 5/9) for sub-meter TWR/TDOA ranging; SPI host interface. On the Makerfabs ESP32-UWB DW3000 board.

chips.name: Everest ES7210 4-channel audio ADC
chips.summary: 4-channel audio ADC/codec on the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Audio board, I2C control + I2S data.

chips.name: Espressif ESP32-C6 WiFi6 SoC
chips.summary: RISC-V WiFi 6 + 802.15.4 SoC; supports ESP-CSI capture (242-subcarrier HE-LTF) for presence/motion/breathing sensing and radar bridging.

chips.name: ESP32-S2FH4 (ESPARGOS per-antenna MCU)
chips.summary: Single-core Xtensa WiFi MCU; ESPARGOS uses 8 of them (one per antenna) to extract phase-coherent WiFi Channel State Information.

chips.name: Espressif ESP32-S3 SoC
chips.role: WiFi/BLE MCU; radar bridge + 64-subcarrier WiFi-CSI node + audio/display host
chips.summary: Dual-core Xtensa WiFi/BLE SoC used as the radar UART bridge, 64-subcarrier CSI node, and audio/display node host.

chips.name: Samsung Exynos 5422
chips.summary: SoC: big.LITTLE octa-core used in Pi4J-supported SBCs.

chips.name: TI FDC2214
chips.summary: 28-bit, 4-channel capacitance-to-digital converter for E-field / proximity body-presence sensing. I2C. Coarse; clothing/humidity confound.

chips.name: GT911 capacitive touch controller
chips.summary: I2C projected-capacitive touch controller (up to 5 points) on the CrowPanel ESP32-S3 display; in-tree HAL-agnostic driver.

chips.name: TDK InvenSense ICM-20948
chips.summary: Low-power 9-axis motion sensor (accel+gyro+AK09916 mag) with optional on-chip DMP. I2C/SPI.

chips.name: TDK ICS-41350 PDM MEMS microphone
chips.summary: 2-wire PDM digital MEMS microphone, a PDM backend option for the audio sentry node.

chips.name: TDK ICS-43432 I2S MEMS microphone
chips.summary: 3-wire I2S digital MEMS microphone, a likely match for a generic ESP32 + mic I2S_STD backend.

chips.name: Infineon BGT60LTR11AIP 60 GHz Doppler radar (AIP)
chips.summary: 1Tx1Rx antenna-in-package 60 GHz Doppler, ~7 m, <2 mW, built-in motion + direction detection; wake tier (no phase/cycle stream).

chips.name: Infineon BGT60UTR11AIP 60 GHz wideband radar (AIP)
chips.role: 60 GHz FMCW AIP, sub-mm motion / vitals-capable MMIC
chips.summary: 1Tx/1Rx 57.4-63 GHz (5.6 GHz BW) antenna-in-package FMCW; presence to 15 m, mm-precise range, gestures, vital signs via sub-mm motion. OPN BGT60UTR11AIPXUMA1.

chips.name: INMP441 I2S MEMS microphone
chips.summary: Omnidirectional bottom-port I2S digital MEMS microphone; the sensor element of the first fully-journaled WeftOS sensor node.

chips.name: IRLZ44N logic-level N-MOSFET
chips.role: half-bridge switch for the HV pulser
chips.summary: Logic-level N-channel power MOSFET forming the half-bridge that drives the pulser step-up transformer in the imaging sonar buoy.

chips.name: TI IWR6843
chips.role: 60 GHz MIMO FMCW radar (3TX x 4RX) for research-grade pose / MMG
chips.summary: 60 GHz FMCW MIMO radar, 3 TX x 4 RX (12 virtual array), 4 GHz BW, raw IF via DCA1000 (LVDS->GigE). Canonical research chip for radar pose and radar MMG.

chips.name: J201 N-channel JFET
chips.role: source-follower buffer for the piezo hydrophone
chips.summary: N-channel JFET used as the high-impedance source-follower buffer in the DIY piezo hydrophone (10 MOhm gate, 10 kOhm source, 3.3 V).

spec.circuit: source follower, 10 MOhm gate / 10 kOhm source @ 3.3 V

chips.name: LM393
chips.summary: The comparator on the KY-038 sound module: compares the mic level against the trimpot to drive the digital DO output.

chips.name: ST LSM6DSV
chips.summary: 6-axis accel+gyro IMU (no magnetometer) with ST's sensor-fusion low-power path; I2C/SPI.

chips.name: Maxim MAX30102
chips.role: Integrated pulse-oximetry / heart-rate optical PPG sensor
chips.summary: Red + IR LED optical PPG module with photodetector and AFE; derives HR and SpO2 (±2 BPM, ±2% SpO2). I2C.

chips.name: Maxim MAX98357A
chips.summary: 3.2W mono Class-D I2S DAC + amplifier; drives a small speaker directly from I2S. For companion coaching-audio output.

chips.name: MCP33131D-10 16-bit SAR ADC
chips.role: 1 MSPS 16-bit SAR ADC (SPI) for acoustic capture
chips.summary: 1 MSPS 16-bit SPI SAR ADC chosen as the RX capture ADC in the imaging sonar buoy analog chain (AD8021 LNA -> MCP33131D -> ESP32-S3 SPI DMA).

chips.name: MCP6022 dual op-amp
chips.summary: Dual rail-to-rail op-amp used for the hydrophone band-pass filter stage in the dry chamber of the DIY sonobuoy.

chips.name: Melexis MLX90640 32x24 FIR thermopile array
chips.summary: 32x24-pixel far-infrared thermopile array providing a low-res thermal image over I2C.

chips.name: Melexis MLX90614
chips.role: Non-contact IR thermometer (object + ambient temp) over SMBus
chips.summary: Single-zone IR thermopile thermometer, object + ambient temperature in 0.01°C steps, range -70..+380°C, SMBus/I2C @ 0x5A (100 kHz cap).

chips.name: MPU-6050 6-axis IMU
chips.summary: 6-axis IMU with onboard DMP/FIFO; the low-cost motion baseline (no magnetometer).

chips.name: MediaTek MT6761 (Helio A22)
chips.role: Application SoC — the Mentra Live glasses compute/camera/WiFi/display host
chips.summary: Quad Cortex-A53 @ 2GHz SoC with 2GB RAM running Android 11 on the Mentra Live glasses. Integrated ISP v3 (HAL3) for camera, combo WiFi+BT+GPS (GPS disabled, wmtWifi proprietary; no CSI). Hosts IMU via Android SensorManager.

chips.name: u-blox NEO-6M
chips.summary: u-blox gen-6 GPS receiver. The silicon in the GY-NEO6MV2 and GT-U7 modules. Has a 1PPS TIMEPULSE output (~30 ns RMS) usable as a timing reference after a fix.

chips.name: u-blox NEO-7M
chips.summary: u-blox gen-7 GPS receiver: faster fix and up to 10 Hz vs the NEO-6M. 1PPS TIMEPULSE output.

chips.name: Nordic nRF52833
chips.summary: Bluetooth LE 5 / 802.15.4 SoC with a Cortex-M4F. Hosts the UWB stack and BLE link inside the DWM3001C module.

chips.name: Nordic nRF5340
chips.role: BLE SoC for the MCU-class MentraOS glasses firmware (mcu_client), Zephyr RTOS
chips.summary: Dual Cortex-M33 BLE 5 SoC targeted by the MentraOS mcu_client firmware (Zephyr). Used for the non-Android MCU-based MentraOS glasses; phone link via Protobuf BLE (mentraos_ble.proto).

chips.name: OmniVision OV5640
chips.role: 5MP autofocus CMOS image sensor (companion training camera; DVP + SCCB)
chips.summary: 5 MP autofocus CMOS image sensor with DVP parallel output and SCCB (I2C) control; onboard JPEG. Used for pose-label training capture on Node A1 (off by default).

chips.name: QMC5883L
chips.summary: 3-axis magnetic sensor, I2C 0x0D, HMC5883L-pin-compatible. The compass on the HGLRC M100 Pro; gives magnetic heading.

chips.name: Qorvo DW3000 UWB transceiver IC
chips.summary: UWB transceiver IC for TWR/TDoA ranging (~10 cm), ch 5/9, Apple U1/U2 interop; the silicon inside DWM3000.

chips.name: RP2040 dual-core microcontroller
chips.summary: Dual-core Cortex-M0+ MCU doing the VL53L7CX housekeeping on DFRobot SEN0628 so the host sees a simplified frame interface.

chips.name: Realtek RTL2832U
chips.role: DVB-T demodulator used as the RTL-SDR software-defined radio front-end
chips.summary: USB DVB-T demodulator that, paired with an R820T2-class tuner, forms the RTL-SDR; streams raw IQ for passive RF reception and rtl_433 decoding.

chips.name: S3KM111L
chips.summary: Single-chip 24 GHz presence + ranging radar that drives the RD-03E module (and its RD-03D tracking sibling).

chips.name: Samsung ISOCELL HP2
chips.role: 200 MP 1/1.3" CMOS image sensor (Galaxy S25 Ultra main camera)
chips.summary: 200 MP 1/1.3" mobile image sensor used as the S25 Ultra wide main camera (companion swarm-node phone, not glasses).

chips.name: Samsung ISOCELL JN1
chips.role: 50 MP CMOS image sensor (Galaxy S25 Ultra ultra-wide camera)
chips.summary: 50 MP mobile image sensor used as the S25 Ultra ultra-wide camera (companion phone, not glasses).

chips.name: SCD41 photoacoustic CO2 sensor
chips.summary: Miniature photoacoustic CO2 sensor (400-5000 ppm) that also reports temperature and humidity.

chips.name: Sensirion SGP30
chips.summary: MOx multi-pixel gas sensor outputting TVOC and eCO2 over I2C; on-chip baseline compensation.

chips.name: SGP40 VOC gas sensor
chips.summary: MOx gas sensor whose raw signal is converted to a 1-500 VOC Index; SGP41 adds an NOx channel.

chips.name: Sensirion SGP41
chips.summary: MOx gas sensor outputting VOC and NOx index signals over I2C (with Sensirion gas-index algorithm).

chips.name: Sony IMX754
chips.role: 10 MP 1/3.52" CMOS image sensor (Galaxy S25 Ultra 3x telephoto)
chips.summary: 10 MP 1/3.52" mobile image sensor used as the S25 Ultra 3x telephoto camera (companion phone, not glasses).

chips.name: Sony IMX984
chips.role: 50 MP CMOS image sensor (Galaxy S25 Ultra 5x periscope)
chips.summary: 50 MP mobile image sensor used as the S25 Ultra 5x periscope camera (companion phone, not glasses).

chips.name: Knowles SPH0645LM4H PDM/I2S MEMS microphone
chips.summary: Digital MEMS mic used as a PDM/I2S backend option for the audio sentry node.

chips.name: Solomon Systech SSD1306
chips.summary: OLED/PLED controller-driver for up to 128x64 monochrome panels; I2C @ 0x3C or SPI. Used for the Node A1 0.96" status OLED.

chips.name: ST MP34DT06 PDM MEMS microphone
chips.summary: 2-wire PDM digital MEMS microphone, a PDM backend option for the audio sentry node.

chips.name: ST STM32L431
chips.role: Onboard host MCU on the Acconeer XM125 module (exposes radar over I2C/SPI)
chips.summary: Cortex-M4 MCU that hosts the A121 on the XM125 module and exposes distance/presence/breath services over I2C/SPI.

chips.name: ST STM32N6
chips.role: Cortex-M55 MCU with Neural-ART NPU (~600 GOPS) for edge AI
chips.summary: STM32N6 MCU with Cortex-M55 and an on-chip Neural-ART NPU (~600 GOPS); candidate low-power edge pose inference (on NUCLEO-N657X0-Q).

chips.name: Semtech SX1262
chips.role: Sub-GHz LoRa transceiver (on Heltec V4 node)
chips.summary: LoRa / (G)FSK sub-GHz transceiver up to +22 dBm (27 dBm on the Heltec module) for long-range mesh telemetry.

spec.tx_power: up to 27 dBm on Heltec V4

chips.name: TC4427A dual MOSFET gate driver
chips.role: gate driver for the imaging-tier pulser
chips.summary: Dual high-speed MOSFET gate driver feeding an IRLZ44N half-bridge + step-up transformer for the high-voltage imaging sonar pulser.

spec.role_here: ESP32 GPIO -> TC4427A -> IRLZ44N half-bridge -> step-up xfmr

chips.name: TI ADS1292R ECG/respiration AFE
chips.summary: 2-channel 24-bit simultaneous-sampling ECG AFE with impedance-respiration channel; timing/phase test reference.

chips.name: TI AWR1642 76-81 GHz automotive FMCW radar SoC
chips.summary: 76-81 GHz automotive FMCW radar SoC; cited for range-Doppler RR/HR with body-motion cancellation.

chips.name: TI IWRL6432 60 GHz low-power FMCW radar
chips.role: 57-61.5 GHz FMCW radar with Cortex-M4F (in IWRL6432WMOD)
chips.summary: Low-power 57-61.5 GHz FMCW radar (3Rx/2Tx, Cortex-M4F) at the heart of the certified IWRL6432WMOD presence/motion module.

chips.name: TP4056 1S Li-ion charger IC
chips.summary: Single-cell Li-ion charge-management IC used on the sonobuoy / sensor-node battery subsystem (18650 + TP4056 + AP2112 LDO).

chips.name: TPS61023 boost converter
chips.role: boost converter for the pulser HV intermediate rail
chips.summary: Boost converter stepping up to a ~12 V intermediate rail for ~24 Vpp piezo drive when extra TX range is needed.

chips.name: u-blox M10 (UBX-M10050)
chips.summary: u-blox 10th-gen concurrent multi-GNSS receiver (GPS+GLONASS+Galileo+BeiDou). Fast, sensitive, low power. The chip in the HGLRC M100 Pro. Has TIMEPULSE internally (not always broken out on FPV boards).

chips.name: VL53L1X single-zone ToF ranger

chips.summary: FlightSense 8x8 multizone Time-of-Flight sensor ranging to ~400 cm with a wide 65-degree FoV over I2C/SPI; successor to the VL53L5CX for gesture and presence.

chips.name: ST IMP23ABSU — Analog MEMS microphone (ultrasound)
chips.summary: Analog MEMS microphone with wide, flat frequency response extending to ~80 kHz for ultrasonic and condition-monitoring applications.

chips.name: ST MP23DB01HP — PDM MEMS microphone (high AOP)
chips.summary: Digital PDM MEMS microphone with high acoustic overload point (~135 dBSPL) and 64 dB SNR for loud or high-dynamic-range audio capture.

chips.name: ST ISM330DHCX — Industrial 6-axis IMU with ML core
chips.summary: Industrial-grade 6-axis IMU (3-axis accel + 3-axis gyro) with an embedded machine-learning core and finite-state machine, over I2C/SPI; for condition monitoring and motion AI.

chips.name: ST H3LIS331DL — High-g 3-axis MEMS accelerometer
chips.summary: High-g 3-axis accelerometer with selectable +/-100/200/400 g full scale over I2C/SPI; for shock, impact and vibration measurement.

chips.name: ST AIS2DW12 — Automotive 3-axis MEMS accelerometer
chips.summary: Automotive-qualified (AEC-Q100) ultra-low-power 3-axis accelerometer with +/-2/4/8/16 g full scale over I2C/SPI.

chips.name: Epson RX8130CE I2C RTC
chips.role: I2C real-time clock with built-in 32.768 kHz crystal
chips.summary: Factory-adjusted 32.768 kHz RTC module, Akizuki sale code 132109. Timestamps a scan and holds time across power loss. A 32.768 kHz tick is 30.5 us, about 1 cm of sound, so the echo stopwatch stays a faster MCU counter.

spec.functions: clock, calendar, alarm, timer, power switch, charge control, delayed reset

chips.name: sensiBel SBM100B optical MEMS microphone
chips.summary: Shipping optical MEMS microphone. A VCSEL and photodetector read diaphragm motion, so one capsule holds a quiet room and a loud chirp. 80 dBA SNR, 14 dBA noise floor, 146 dB SPL overload, 132 dB dynamic range. PDM, I2S, and 8-channel TDM share one clock. The published SNR window is 20 Hz to 20 kHz.

spec.sensing: optical interferometry of diaphragm displacement (VCSEL, grating, photodetector)
spec.interface: PDM, I2S, TDM 8-channel; optional I2C for filters and gain
spec.package: 6 x 3.8 x 2.47 mm, bottom port, SMD
spec.variants: one acoustic spec across PDM, I2S, and TDM
